data.title: AI-generated voice messages impersonate senior U.S. officials in an ongoing smishing and vishing campaign
data.targets: officials' family members and personal acquaintances

evidence: Since at least 2023, malicious actors have sent text messages and AI -generated voice messages

data.title: EU financial supervisors warn fraudsters use AI-generated voices or videos to impersonate friends or family
data.issuer: European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA)

evidence: Technologies like AI and blockchain make frauds and scams more convincing and harder to detect. For example, AI-generated voices or videos can impersonate friends or family members.

data.title: Macao recorded its first AI deepfake fraud cases in 2025: 3 cases reported from late April to end-November, with no actual losses
data.issuer: Government Information Bureau, Macao SAR (Secretary for Security crime briefing)

evidence: 尤其是今年4月底，本澳首次出現涉及AI深偽技術的詐騙案件，至11月底警方已接報3宗個案，雖未造成實際損失，但仍需要公眾保持高度警惕

data.title: International action hits crypto investment fraud network and the affiliate marketers behind its deepfake social media ads

evidence: Coordinated actions were taken against the companies and suspects behind fraudulent advertising campaigns on social media platforms. In recent years, deceptive advertisements impersonating renowned media outlets, celebrities and politicians – often using deepfake videos

data.title: Task force warns of widespread AI scams that clone voices and fake faces to pose as friends, colleagues or family
data.issuer: Satgas PASTI (Task Force on Illegal Financial Activities), Financial Services Authority (OJK)

evidence: Satuan Tugas Pemberantasan Aktivitas Keuangan Ilegal (Satgas PASTI) mengimbau masyarakat untuk mewaspadai modus penipuan memanfaatkan Artificial Intelligence (AI) yang marak terjadi dan menimbulkan kerugian.

data.title: Central bank says suspects who made AI fake videos from victims' photos were testing Chinese, not Thai, bank face checks

evidence: ที่ใช้ AI สร้างคลิปวิดีโอปลอมจากภาพนิ่งของเหยื่อ เพื่อหลอกระบบยืนยันตัวตนของธนาคารนั้น จากการตรวจสอบพบว่า เป็นกรณี scammer ชาวจีนทดสอบระบบยืนยันตัวตนโดยใช้ข้อมูลและแอปพลิเคชั่นของจีนเท่านั้น

data.title: Central Bank of Ireland sees rise in AI-made deepfake ads and profiles impersonating public figures to push fake investment platforms

evidence: The Central Bank has noted a rise in AI being used to create realistic social media ads and profiles impersonating public or business figures

data.title: Scam groups use AI-generated lifelike videos of public figures to endorse products and investments, police warn
data.issuer: Criminal Investigation Bureau, National Police Agency (Taiwan)

evidence: 揭露詐騙集團結合人工智慧（AI）影片生成技術，製作假冒公眾人物擬真影片行騙的最新態樣，呼籲全民提高警覺、強化識詐能力，防範受害。
